title: Incorporate best-in-class UX/content patterns from competitor spray-foam service websites

requirements.text: Update the storefront homepage to incorporate best-in-class spray-foam contractor website UX patterns inspired by: https://coldcountrysprayfoam.com, https://www.rrso.ca, https://www.beyondfoam.com, https://www.pbsprayfoam.com. Add above-the-fold CTAs and trust-building sections while keeping the existing product grid and shopping flow intact.

quotes: get the best things out of the websites please

acceptanceCriteria: The homepage hero includes at least two clear primary CTAs (e.g., “Shop Products” and “Request a Quote”) and a short value proposition.

The homepage includes new sections commonly found on top competitor service sites, such as: service highlights, “Why choose us”/benefits, simple process steps, testimonial/reviews section (placeholder content allowed), and an FAQ accordion.
The existing product listing (active products grid with loading/error/empty states) still renders and remains discoverable without additional clicks.
All new user-facing text is in English.

requirements.text: Add a dedicated “Request a Quote” page with a lead capture form suitable for spray-foam service inquiries (not product checkout). Include validation and a success state after submission.
acceptanceCriteria: A new route exists for requesting a quote (e.g., /request-quote) and is accessible from the header navigation and homepage CTA.
The quote form collects at minimum: name, email and/or phone, service address (street/city/state(or province)/zip/country), and a free-text project description.
Client-side validation requires: name, at least one contact method (email or phone), and a project description; validation messages are shown inline.
On successful submit, the UI displays a confirmation message and clears or disables the form to prevent accidental re-submission.
The form submission persists the inquiry in the backend and does not require Internet Identity login.

requirements.text: Implement backend support for storing and managing service quote inquiries (leads) submitted from the “Request a Quote” form, including an admin-only view/update capability.

quotes: get the best things out of the websites please

acceptanceCriteria: The backend exposes a public method to submit a quote inquiry that can be called by unauthenticated/guest users without trapping for authorization.
The backend stores each inquiry with a unique incrementing ID and a timestamp.
The backend provides admin-only methods to list all inquiries and update an inquiry status (e.g., new/contacted/closed). Non-admin callers are rejected.
Backend methods return deterministic, serializable types that can be consumed by the existing React/React Query patterns.

requirements.text: Add an admin page for managing quote inquiries (leads) alongside existing admin products/orders, including status updates and basic inquiry details.

quotes: make the website with the best features from each website

acceptanceCriteria: A new admin route exists (e.g., /admin/leads) within the existing AdminLayout authorization guard.
The page lists submitted inquiries with key fields (created time, name, contact info, location summary, short preview of message) and current status.
Admins can update an inquiry’s status from the UI and see the change reflected without a full reload (React Query invalidation or equivalent).
The existing admin pages (/admin/products and /admin/orders) remain unchanged in behavior.

requirements.text: Add contractor-style “trust signals” and service-company footer/header improvements inspired by competitor sites, without adding external integrations (no email service, no live chat).

quotes: get the best things out of the websites please

acceptanceCriteria: Header navigation includes links suitable for a service company (at least: Products, Request a Quote, Admin) while keeping cart access intact.
Footer includes a more service-company-appropriate contact block (placeholder phone/email allowed), service area text (placeholder allowed), and quick links including Request a Quote.
Homepage includes a “trust signals” area (e.g., badges like “Licensed & Insured”, “Free Estimates”, “Energy Efficiency”, “Warranty”) using purely on-site UI elements (no third-party embeds).

constraints: Use English for all user-facing text.
Do not edit files under frontend/immutablePaths (including Internet Identity and actor hooks, and frontend/src/components/ui). Compose existing UI components instead.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not add third-party integrations (no external email/SMS/chat/review embeds).
nonGoals: Do not clone or copy competitor site code or proprietary content; only incorporate generalized UX/content patterns with original text and placeholder content where needed.
Do not replace the existing product storefront/cart/checkout/order flow; enhancements must be additive.
No SEO/analytics integrations or external marketing pixels.
No real-time chat or messaging features.
